description: TASK 1340 clipboard paste fixture. Every payload is a thing a real clipboard can hand the OSL Chat composer. `kind` says what the user copied: "text" is plain or rich text, "object" is a non-image clipboard object (a spreadsheet range, a file blob), "image" is the only kind clipboard intake may turn into an attachment. Non-image payloads are the point of this fixture: a fixture without them fails the check.

payloads.name: plain-text
payloads.text: Meeting moved to 19:00 - bring the notes, not the laptop.
